data.name: Nicholas
data.gender_notes: Nicholas is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek nikē, 'victory', + laos, 'people' — 'victory of the people'. Its root is Greek nikē + laos. Saint Nicholas, bishop of Myra. Nicholas is a Greek name meaning “Victory of the people”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nicholas expresses “Victory of the people”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek nikē, 'victory', + laos, 'people' — 'victory of the people'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicholas total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: From which word is Nicholas derived?
faq.a: From the Greek nikē, 'victory', + laos, 'people' — 'victory of the people'.

faq.q: Is Nicholas mentioned in scripture or history?
What is the historical or scriptural reference for Nicholas?
What is the lucky number for Nicholas?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Nicholas is 9 (ruling planet Mars). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Nicholas?
faq.a: Tuesday is the traditional association for Nicholas. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Nicholas?
faq.a: Red Coral is the traditional association for Nicholas. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Nicholas?
faq.a: Red, Crimson are the traditional associations for Nicholas. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Nicholas?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicholas total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Nicholas?
faq.a: The meaning of Nicholas carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Nicholas have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Nicholas is recorded as a christian name meaning “Victory of the people”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Nicholas?
faq.a: In English, Nicholas is rendered as “Victory of the people”.

faq.q: Is Nicholas suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Nicholas is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
